title: Autonomous MBots
summary: Motion analysis and real-time safety research for mobile robots, using wheel encoder data and computer vision.
overview: My work with MBots focused on motion analysis and real-time safety. I used wheel encoder data to assess velocity and acceleration accuracy and analyze how the robots moved over time.
In the MARVL Lab, I also contributed to computer vision and low-level state estimation used to assess robot motion relative to the surrounding environment.

photo.alt: A wheeled MBot with a LiDAR scanner and other onboard electronics on an outdoor table.

title: Personal Portfolio
summary: An accessible static portfolio generated from shared templates, with interactive project filters and saved appearance preferences.
overview: I built this portfolio with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. A small Python build script combines shared templates and structured content into static pages.
The site uses progressive enhancement for project filters, mobile navigation, and saved appearance preferences, while keeping the page content available in the generated HTML.

title: Handwritten Character Recognition
summary: A Julia comparison of feedforward and convolutional neural networks on handwritten English characters.
overview: For this project, I compared feedforward and convolutional neural networks on handwritten English characters using Julia. I trained the models with the handwritten character dataset by Cohen, Afshar, Tapson, and van Schaik.
I looked at accuracy, confusion matrices, and learning curves to understand which characters each model recognized well and where it struggled.

photo.alt: A handwritten R alongside neural-network outputs; the predicted label is R.

title: 3D Mapping from LiDAR Data
summary: Aligning point clouds from multiple LiDAR scans to build a shared 3D map with Julia.
overview: I used Julia to combine separate LiDAR scans into a 3D map. Each scan captured the scene from a different angle, so the project involved processing the point clouds and aligning them in a shared coordinate frame.
The resulting visualization let me inspect how the scans fit together and spot problems in the alignment.

title: Orbital Satellite Simulation
summary: Using a ground robot to study aspects of satellite motion.
overview: In the VODCA Lab, I helped connect a satellite orbit simulation to an omnidirectional ground rover used as a physical test platform. I worked on lower-level control between the simulated models and physical robots to support real-time data collection and analysis.
The goal was to represent aspects of satellite motion in a controlled lab space, within the physical limits of the MBots.

photo.alt: An omnidirectional rover with three roller wheels and onboard electronics.

title: Auction Notification System
summary: A Python tool that filters online auction listings and sends alerts when items match configured criteria.
overview: I built this Python tool to keep track of online auctions without repeatedly checking listings by hand. It collects listings, filters them by details such as keywords and price, and sends a notification when an item matches.
The project brought together web scraping, APIs, and an alert workflow, with retries and rate limiting to handle changes in the listing sources.

title: Game Development Experiments
summary: Solo game projects with Unity and C#, covering gameplay, level design, and assets made in Blender.
overview: I work on solo game projects in Unity, using C# for gameplay and Blender to create game assets.
The projects bring together gameplay programming, level design, and asset creation across the Unity and Blender toolchain.

title: Quadplane Development
summary: Flight-control, hardware integration, and testing for an aircraft with vertical takeoff and fixed-wing flight.
overview: I contributed to developing a hybrid aircraft that combines vertical takeoff with fixed-wing flight. My work focused on flight-control logic, hardware integration, and testing how the aircraft behaved across operating modes.
The project included modes for simulated circular motion and controlled flight.

photo.alt: A hybrid quadplane with fixed wings and vertical-lift propellers on a table at a flying field.
